The ideal candidate will exhibit exceptional customer service skills, be motivated, well organized, detailed oriented and dependable. cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
At least 3 years working experience in the RF regulatory (CE/ FCC/ ISED) related testing lab.
Good knowledge and operational skills on RF regulatory (CE/ FCC/ ISED) test equipment.
Good knowledge of [Location masked] RF regulatory testing.
Experience using lab test equipment including spectrum analyzer, power meters, communication tester, call box etc.
Experience with RF testing for: Wi-Fi, BT, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, RFID, LoRa, transmitters.
Experience with RF testing for: CDMA/WCDMA, GSM/EDGE, LTE, 5GNR transmitters.

Bachelor's degree in engineering or 4 years or equivalent work experience.
Computer literacy including Microsoft Office applications.
Minimum of 2 years related experience in RF regulatory (CE/ FCC/ ISED).

cond_0115.intro: The primary function of the Wireless Test Engineer is to focus on conducting RF compliance testing. The candidate should have strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting, along with the ability to work independently and within a team structure. The ideal candidate will be well organized, detail oriented, and dependable, with a firm understanding of the following standards: EN 300 328, EN 301 893, EN 300 220/330/440, EN302 502, ETSI EN 301-489, ANSI C63.10, RSS-GEN, FCC Part 15, 22, 24, 27, 90; LP0002.
cond_0115.responsibilities:
Perform RF and EMC testing to CE and FCC standards.
Respond to RF regulatory (e.g. CE/FCC/ISED) related questions from internal and external contacts.
Support RF regulatory (e.g. CE/FCC/ISED) related tests; draft test plans and reports.
Support quality initiatives of the laboratory regarding general maintenance, calibration, and testing processes.
Track and communicate RF related project status as the coordinating interface.
cond_0115.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering or 4 years of equivalent work experience.
At least 3 years of working experience in an RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED) related testing lab.
Good knowledge and operational skills on RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED) test equipment.
Good knowledge of RF regulatory testing.
Experience using lab test equipment including spectrum analyzer, power meters, communication tester, call box, etc.
Experience with RF testing for: Wi-Fi, BT, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, RFID, LoRa, transmitters.
Experience with RF testing for: CDMA/WCDMA, GSM/EDGE, LTE, 5GNR transmitters.
Experience performing Power, OBW, PSD, Blocking, Adaptivity, and DFS testing.
Computer literacy including Microsoft Office applications.
Minimum of 2 years of related experience in RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED).
Preferred Requirements
Good knowledge of RF laboratory services, preferably within the TIC industry.
Familiarity with ISO 17025 quality system and general understanding of standard interpretation.
Familiarity with test automation using communication protocols including GPIB, USB, TCP-IP.
Experience with EMC 32, Elektra, WMC 32, BAT EMC, WMS 32.
TCB certification.

The ideal candidate will be well organized, detail oriented, and dependable, with a firm understanding of the following standards: EN 300 328, EN 301 893, EN 300 220/330/440, EN302 502, ETSI EN 301-489, ANSI C63.10, RSS-GEN, FCC Part 15, 22, 24, 27, 90; LP0002.
cond_0178.responsibilities:
Perform RF and EMC testing to CE and FCC standards.
Respond to RF regulatory (e.g. CE/FCC/ISED) related questions from internal and external contacts.
Support RF regulatory (e.g. CE/FCC/ISED) related tests, draft test plans and reports.
Support quality initiatives of the laboratory regarding general maintenance, calibration, testing process, etc.
Track and communicate status of RF related projects to relevant parties as required.
cond_0178.requirements:
Good knowledge and operational skills on RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED) test equipment.
Good knowledge of [Location masked] RF regulatory testing.
Good knowledge of RF laboratory services, preferably within the TIC industry.
At least 3 years working experience in an RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED) related testing lab.
Experience using lab test equipment including spectrum analyzer, power meters, communication tester, call box, etc.
Experience with RF testing for: Wi-Fi, BT, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, RFID, LoRa, transmitters.
Experience with RF testing for: CDMA/WCDMA, GSM/EDGE, LTE, 5GNR transmitters.
Experience performing Power, OBW, PSD, Blocking, Adaptivity, and DFS testing.
Familiar with ISO 17025 quality system and general understanding of standard explanation.
Familiar with test automation using communication protocols including GPIB, USB, TCP-IP.
Bachelor's degree in engineering or 4 years of equivalent work experience required.
Computer literacy required including Microsoft Office applications.
Experience with EMC 32, Elektra, WMC 32, BAT EMC, WMS 32.
Minimum of 2 years related experience in RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED).
TCB certification a plus.

Minimum Requirements

cond_0351.intro: We are looking for a Wireless Test Engineer to join our team. The primary focus of this role is conducting RF compliance testing. Day-to-day work involves coordinating with customers and colleagues on test setup, measurement, and documentation. The role calls for strong written and verbal communication skills, good organization, and attention to detail.
cond_0351.responsibilities:
Work alongside the team to perform RF and EMC testing to CE and FCC standards.
Help address RF regulatory (e.g. CE/FCC/ISED) related questions from internal and external contacts.
Support RF regulatory testing, and collaborate on drafting test plans and reports.
Contribute to quality initiatives in the laboratory, including general maintenance, calibration, and testing processes.
Coordinate and communicate RF-related project tracking across relevant contacts.
cond_0351.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
At least 3 years of working experience in an RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED) related testing lab.
Good knowledge and operational skills with RF regulatory test equipment.
Good knowledge of RF regulatory testing.
Experience using lab test equipment including spectrum analyzer, power meters, communication tester, call box, etc.
Experience with RF testing for: Wi-Fi, BT, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, RFID, LoRa, transmitters.
Experience with RF testing for: CDMA/WCDMA, GSM/EDGE, LTE, 5GNR transmitters.
Experience performing Power, OBW, PSD, Blocking, Adaptivity, and DFS testing.
Bachelor's degree in engineering or 4 years of equivalent work experience.
Computer literacy including Microsoft Office applications.
Minimum of 2 years of related experience in RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED).
Firm understanding of standards: EN 300 328, EN 301 893, EN 300 220/330/440, EN302 502, ETSI EN 301-489, ANSI C63.10, RSS-GEN, FCC Part 15, 22, 24, 27, 90; LP0002.
Preferred Requirements
Good knowledge of RF laboratory services, preferably within the TIC industry.
Familiarity with ISO 17025 quality system and general understanding of standard interpretation.
Familiarity with test automation using communication protocols including GPIB, USB, TCP-IP.
Experience with EMC 32, Elektra, WMC 32, BAT EMC, WMS 32.
TCB certification.

The candidate should have strong written and verbal communication skills and be comfortable working both independently and within a team. The ideal candidate will have solid customer service skills, be well organized, detail oriented, and dependable, with a firm understanding of the following standards: EN 300 328, EN 301 893, EN 300 220/330/440, EN302 502, ETSI EN 301-489, ANSI C63.10, RSS-GEN, FCC Part 15, 22, 24, 27, 90; LP0002.
cond_0573.responsibilities:
Perform RF and EMC testing to CE and FCC standards.
Answer RF regulatory (e.g. CE/FCC/ISED) related questions from internal and external contacts on a regular basis, explaining requirements and clarifying guidance directly.
Support RF regulatory (e.g. CE/FCC/ISED) related tests, draft test plans and reports.
Support quality initiatives of the laboratory regarding general maintenance, calibration, testing process, etc.
Actively track and communicate RF related projects, staying in regular contact with relevant parties to keep things moving.
cond_0573.requirements:
Good knowledge and operational skills on RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED) test equipment.
Good knowledge of [Location masked] RF regulatory testing.
Good knowledge of RF laboratory services, preferably within the TIC industry.
At least 3 years working experience in an RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED) related testing lab.
Experience using lab test equipment including spectrum analyzer, power meters, communication tester, call box, etc.
Experience with RF testing for: Wi-Fi, BT, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, RFID, LoRa, transmitters.
Experience with RF testing for: CDMA/WCDMA, GSM/EDGE, LTE, 5GNR transmitters.
Experience performing Power, OBW, PSD, Blocking, Adaptivity and DFS testing.
Familiar with ISO 17025 quality system and general understanding of standard explanation.
Familiar with test automation using communication protocols including GPIB, USB, TCP-IP.
Bachelor's degree in engineering or 4 years of equivalent work experience required.
Computer literacy required including Microsoft Office applications.
EMC 32, Elektra, WMC 32, BAT EMC, WMS 32.
Minimum of 2 years related experience in RF regulatory (CE/FCC/ISED).
TCB certification a plus.
